name: Mattan
overview: The name Mattan appears in Scripture primarily as a priest of Baal who was killed during the reforming actions of the people in Jerusalem, as they tore down the idolatrous altars and images associated with Baal worship (2 Kings 11:18; 2 Chronicles 23:17). This event highlights the decisive rejection of false gods and the restoration of true worship to the LORD. Additionally, Mattan is identified as the father of Shephatiah, connecting him to the narrative surrounding Jeremiah and the prophetic ministry during a tumultuous period in Judah's history (Jeremiah 38:1). Thus, Mattan's mention serves both as a symbol of idolatry's defeat and as a genealogical link within the people of God.
